beats.text: Near Lake Pampa lived Shabari, an aged devotee who had waited years for Rama. She was a tribal woman, born far from any palace.
As a young girl, she had run away from home to serve the sage Matanga. Before he died, he told her: 'Wait here. One day, Rama will come.'
Each day she gathered the sweetest berries, tasting each one to be sure it was good, as later tellings lovingly say.
And one day, two princes walked up the path. Shabari fell at Rama's feet, weeping.
When Rama finally came, he happily ate the berries she had already tasted. Lakshmana hesitated. Rama did not.
He cared nothing for rank or custom. He saw only her love.
Shabari told them where to find Sugriva. Then, her life's wish fulfilled, she entered a sacred fire and rose to heaven.
